name: Ada Higgins
source:
Ada is the sole daughter of Roy Higgins, an aristocrat living in the Five Towns in New York. After reading her father's remorseful suicide note and the mysterious invitation he was sent, Ada asks detective [url=/c95244]Ikeda[/url] to investigate her father's death as well as Shironagasu Island.

She is in poor health and has a pale complexion.

[From [url=https://tabinomichi.jp/shironagasu/en/]official website[/url]]
